reasons: Cited text matches the playbook preferred position exactly: Section 28.1 selects New York law and Section 28.2 gives exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County with irrevocable submission and venue/forum waiver.
No arbitration seat or foreign venue is present; the mutual temporary-injunctive-relief carve-out is customary and does not displace the exclusive forum.
Consistent with a compliant finding, the redline is unchanged and no counterparty comment is proposed; deterministic check confirms governing law is within the accepted set.
